comment: Hostnames an agent container may CONNECT to on port 443, and nothing else. Starter entries are the harness model and login endpoints from the vendors' docs/source (Claude Code network-config docs; openai/codex login and responses clients); auto-update and telemetry are switched off in minerva-harness, so their hosts are absent. The P1b smoke test logs every denied host, and each addition is reviewed one by one, never by widening to a broad suffix. 'suffix' entries start with '.' and match on a label boundary.
